description: Deraniyagala Pradeshiya Sabha- Roads and Narrow Roads 2nd Gazette
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - the official confirmation and registration of roads and narrow roads owned by the Deraniyagala Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules with road names, coordinates, lengths, and widths, which constitutes land registration and property ownership documentation. The content focuses entirely on land/property identification and ownership confirmation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
